correctness.rationale: For all k>=5 the Rauzy-graph presentation supplies two first-return loops with lengths (F_{k-1},F_k) and digit-one counts (F_{k-3},F_{k-2}). The labeled determinant yields exp(at-pP)+exp(bt-qP)=1, valid for all real t. Two differentiations give P''(0)=uv(aq-bp)^2/(pu+qv)^3; Cassini gives |aq-bp|=1. Scaling by q^3 yields C=UV/(rU+V)^3, and the known Fibonacci cover plateaus yield exactly [C,phi^3 C] as the scaled variance limit set. Distinguishes fixed-cover CLT from varying cover. Independently recomputed Cassini and numerical variance for k=5..10, converging toward 0.517496; these finite checks do not prove all k.
